backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing backend logic for a concrete coating business, with functions to submit and retrieve quote requests and customer reviews stored in in-memory maps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that the '10+ years experience' text in AboutSection.tsx was updated to '7+ years experience'.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source file paths to short human-readable summaries describing each component's purpose and key content.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS entry point importing Tailwind directives and defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React SPA, setting the page title to 'NewGate Concrete Coating' and mounting the app at the #root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that composes the full page layout by rendering Navigation, HeroSection, ServicesSection, FlakeColorsSection, AboutSection, ContactSection, ReviewsSection, and Footer in order.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: About section displaying four icon-based benefit cards for polyaspartic coating, a service areas badge list (Orlando, Tampa, Plant City), and a 'NewGate Difference' stats block showing '7+ Years Experience'.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact form component with validation that submits quote requests to the backend actor, displaying contact info (phone, email, service areas) and a success state after submission.
frontend/src/components/FlakeColorsSecti: Section displaying 17 decorative chip flake color options in a responsive grid, each with a local image and color name, plus a CTA link to the contact section.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with company info, social media links, quick navigation links, contact details, and service areas for NewGate Concrete Coating.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a background image, company tagline, phone CTA, and buttons to scroll to the contact or services sections.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Fixed top navigation bar with scroll-aware styling, smooth-scroll nav links, and a responsive mobile hamburger menu.
frontend/src/components/ReviewsSection.t: Displays customer reviews fetched from the backend and provides a form for submitting new reviews with star rating, service type, and feedback fields.
Renders a grid of four service cards (patio, driveway, pool deck, garage) each with an image, description, and feature tags.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, returning an anonymous actor when unauthenticated and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, managing login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating quote requests and customer reviews via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines a concrete/copper-themed design token system using CSS custom properties for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with oklch-based design tokens for copper and concrete color palettes, custom border radii, fonts, and animation keyframes.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata and feature state for the NewGate Concrete Coating app, recording one existing feature update (changing '10+ years' to '7+ years' in AboutSection).
